answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the violet queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 159 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the umber. The kernel index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 18 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
